evidence.why: Exact aerial guard and grounded destinations.
Collision position flow and unusual enum-return semantics.

reason: Aerial collision dispatches grounded conversion at current frame ONLY for result != GA_Ground. Callee returns GA_Air for a truthy map result unless ft_80081A00 overrides it; enum spelling must not reverse the predicate. Landing is the destination-role interpretation. Conversion has conditional bookkeeping and a ground-validity assertion; descriptive name is supported by actual destination, not rendered text.
